from tool import search_flights, filter_flights, save_to_cache, get_results_from_cache

# Retrieve cached flight search results for Raleigh to Atlanta on May 15, 2025
prior_results = get_results_from_cache(key="flights")

# Define departure and return dates for the round trip
departure_date = ["May 15, 2025"]
return_date = ["May 26, 2025"]

# Search for flights from Raleigh to Atlanta (outbound)
outbound_search = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Raleigh",
    end_airport_city="Atlanta",
    departure_date=departure_date,
    num_layovers=[0, 1],
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Save outbound search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="outbound_flights", value=outbound_search)

# Filter outbound flights (if needed, though cache may already be filtered)
filtered_outbound = filter_flights(
    prior_results=outbound_search,
    start_airport_city="Raleigh",
    end_airport_city="Atlanta",
    departure_date=departure_date,
    num_layovers=[0, 1],
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Search for return flights from Atlanta to Raleigh (return leg)
return_search = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Atlanta",
    end_airport_city="Raleigh",
    departure_date=return_date,
    num_layovers=[0, 1],
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Save return search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="return_flights", value=return_search)

# Filter return flights (if needed)
filtered_return = filter_flights(
    prior_results=return_search,
    start_airport_city="Atlanta",
    end_airport_city="Raleigh",
    departure_date=return_date,
    num_layovers=[0, 1],
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Combine filtered results into a single list for the user
all_flights = filtered_outbound.search_results + filtered_return.search_results

# Prepare query summary for the user

# Output the summary (no need to print results as per instructions)
